### European Lithium securityholders to vote on the Schemes on October 22, 2026


NEW YORK, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML) (“Critical Metals Corp” or the “Company”), a leading critical minerals exploration and mining company, today provided an update on its proposed acquisition of European Lithium Limited (ASX: EUR, FRA: PF8, OTC: EULIF) (“European Lithium”), ahead of the European Lithium securityholder meetings to be held on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


Under the proposed transaction, Critical Metals Corp would acquire 100% of the issued share capital of European Lithium and all of European Lithium’s listed options by way of Court-approved schemes of arrangement under Part 5.1 of the Australian Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), comprising a scheme between European Lithium and its shareholders (the “Share Scheme”) and a scheme between European Lithium and the holders of its listed options (ASX: EUROC) (the “Option Scheme”, and together with the Share Scheme, the “Schemes”). The consideration payable under each Scheme is to be satisfied by the issue of new ordinary shares in Critical Metals Corp.


**Share Scheme Transaction Ratio**


European Lithium has announced that the Share Scheme Transaction Ratio, which sets the number of new Critical Metals Corp shares to be issued for each European Lithium share, has been determined in accordance with the terms of the Share Scheme set out in the scheme booklet released to the ASX on September 15, 2026 (the “Scheme Booklet”).


The ratio is set by reference to the average of the daily volume weighted average price of Critical Metals Corp shares on Nasdaq over the 20 consecutive trading days from September 23, 2026 to October 20, 2026 (the “Scheme VWAP”), subject to a floor price of US$8.00 and a ceiling price of US$16.00.


As the Scheme VWAP is at or below the floor price, the Share Scheme Transaction Ratio is the maximum ratio set out in the Scheme Booklet.


Accordingly, subject to rounding, if the Share Scheme is implemented, European Lithium shareholders will receive 0.045 new Critical Metals Corp shares for each European Lithium share held at the record date. The value of the consideration will change with the Critical Metals Corp share price and the AUD/USD exchange rate.


**Option Scheme Consideration**


The consideration for European Lithium’s listed options will be calculated using the cashless exercise formula set out in the Scheme Booklet, by reference to the Share Scheme Transaction Ratio, the Scheme VWAP and the option exercise price of A$0.10. European Lithium expects to announce the final Option Scheme consideration on or around October 28, 2026.


**Securityholder Meetings and Next Steps**


The general meeting and the meetings of European Lithium shareholders and optionholders to vote on the Schemes (the “Scheme Meetings”) will be held on Thursday, October 22, 2026 in West Leederville, Western Australia. European Lithium’s Independent Board Committee continues to recommend that European Lithium securityholders vote in favor of the Scheme relevant to them, in the absence of a superior proposal and subject to the independent expert continuing to conclude that the relevant Scheme is in the best interests of those securityholders.


Subject to the approval of European Lithium securityholders, the approval of the Supreme Court of Western Australia (the “Court”), and the satisfaction or waiver of the remaining conditions precedent.


**About Critical Metals Corp.**


Critical Metals Corp (Nasdaq: CRML) is a leading mining development company focused on critical metals and minerals, and producing strategic products essential to electrification and next-generation technologies for Europe and its Western world partners. Its flagship Project, Tanbreez, is one of the world’s largest rare earth deposits and is located in Southern Greenland. The deposit is expected to have access to key transportation outlets as the area features year-round direct shipping access via deep water fjords that lead directly to the North Atlantic Ocean.


Another key asset is the Wolfsberg Lithium Project located in Carinthia, 270 km south of Vienna, Austria. The Wolfsberg Lithium Project is the first fully permitted mine in Europe and is strategically located with access to established road and rail infrastructure and is expected to be the next major producer of key lithium products to support the European market. Wolfsberg is well positioned with offtake and downstream partners to become a unique and valuable asset in an expanding geostrategic critical metals portfolio.


With this strategic asset portfolio, Critical Metals Corp is positioned to become a reliable and sustainable supplier of critical minerals essential for defense applications, the clean energy transition, and next-generation technologies in the western world.


For more information, please visit https://www.criticalmetalscorp.com/.
